_meta.verification: A treaty entry marked 'not in force' means the instrument has not met its entry-into-force threshold; it is distinct from India/national law and must never be presented as binding domestic law.
_meta.disclaimer: Treaty texts and status may change. Verify current status with WIPO and the India Code before relying on any treaty obligation.

treaties.full_name: WIPO Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge
signed_by: 141 delegations signed the Final Act at adoption
treaties.entry_into_force_rule: Article 17: 3 months after 15 eligible Parties have deposited instruments of ratification/accession.

key_articles.art_2: Definitions — genetic resources, traditional knowledge associated with genetic resources, source/country of origin.
key_articles.art_3: Disclosure requirement for patent applications based on genetic resources and/or associated traditional knowledge: disclose country of origin or source; if unknown, declaration to that effect allowed.
key_articles.art_6: Information systems — database of where disclosure obligations apply.
key_articles.art_7: Relationship with other international agreements (incl. TRIPS).

treaties.why_it_matters: A future mandatory patent-disclosure obligation parallel to India's existing Section 10(4)(d)(ii) origin disclosure and Biological Diversity Act Section 6 approval.

treaties.full_name: Agreement on Trade-Related Aspects of Intellectual Property Rights (TRIPS)

key_articles.art_27: Patentable subject matter incl. exclusions for methods of medical treatment; biology-exclusion option.
key_articles.art_28: Rights conferred by a patent (India implemented via Patents Act 1970)
key_articles.art_33: 20-year patent term (implemented in India by Patents (Amendment) Act 2002)

treaties.why_it_matters: Baseline minimum patent/TM/copyright standards binding on India and most export destinations.

key_articles.art_15: Access to genetic resources on mutually agreed terms / prior informed consent.
key_articles.art_8j: Respect and preserve traditional knowledge relevant to biodiversity.

treaties.why_it_matters: Foundational source of India's ABS obligations, reflected in the Biological Diversity Act 2002 and Rules 2024.

treaties.full_name: Nagoya Protocol on Access to Genetic Resources and Fair and Equitable Sharing of Benefits Arising from their Utilization

key_articles.art_12: Consideration of Indigenous and local communities' customary laws and traditional knowledge.

treaties.why_it_matters: Operationalizes CBD access/benefit-sharing; informs India's ABS framework and cross-border utilization duties.

key_articles.art_11: Filing date — powers of receiving Office (India = CGPDTM).

treaties.why_it_matters: Route for international patent protection; India is a PCT receiving office; enabling reform was the 1999 Compliance Act.

treaties.full_name: Madrid Protocol Concerning the International Registration of Marks
treaties.why_it_matters: Single international trademark filing covering many countries; India acceded via the Trade Marks (Amendment) Act 2010.

treaties.full_name: Hague Agreement Concerning the International Registration of Industrial Designs (Geneva Act)
treaties.why_it_matters: International design registration route; India is not yet party — Indian applicants use national Designs Act 2000 filing.

treaties.full_name: Budapest Treaty on the International Recognition of the Deposit of Microorganisms for the Purposes of Patent Procedure
treaties.why_it_matters: Required deposit mechanism when a biotech/microbial formulation needs disclosure in patent practice.
